3. What Remira is, and what it is not

What it is

Remira is a personal wellness and information tool. It:

  • Reads glucose data from Apple Health and, optionally, from Dexcom Share or FreeStyle LibreLinkUp
  • Identifies patterns in that data
  • Produces forecasts of likely near-term glucose movement
  • Sends notifications about current and predicted readings
  • Lets you share this information with family members and caregivers you choose

What it is not

Remira is not a medical device. It is not FDA-cleared or FDA-approved.

  • Remira does not diagnose, treat, cure, or prevent any disease
  • Remira does not provide medical advice, clinical assessment, or treatment recommendations
  • Remira does not tell you how much insulin to take, what to eat, or how to change your management
  • Remira does not replace your endocrinologist, physician, diabetes educator, or any member of your care team

Remira describes what your data shows. It does not tell you what to do about it.

Always consult a qualified healthcare professional before changing your insulin dosing, diet, medication, or diabetes management. Never make a treatment decision based only on Remira.

Alerts are not an alarm system

This is important.

Remira’s notifications are supplementary. They are not a substitute for the alarms built into your CGM, and you must not rely on them for safety.

Remira alerts can be delayed, degraded, or fail entirely — because of phone settings, Do Not Disturb, network problems, an expired or interrupted Dexcom connection, notification permissions, battery optimization, a service outage on our side or a third party’s, or a bug.

Keep your CGM’s own alarms enabled and configured with your care team. Treat anything Remira sends as an extra prompt, never as the thing standing between you and a dangerous low.

The same applies to caregivers. A caregiver must never assume that no alert means everything is fine. Absence of a notification is not evidence of safety.

Forecasts are estimates

Forecasts are statistical estimates from past data. Glucose is affected by many things Remira cannot see. Forecasts will sometimes be wrong, sometimes substantially. They are context, not instruction.

You accept these risks

By using Remira you acknowledge that diabetes management carries serious risks including severe hypoglycemia and hyperglycemia; that data may be inaccurate, delayed, incomplete, or unavailable; that acting on Remira’s output without professional guidance could cause harm; and that you remain responsible for your own care decisions.

5. Family accounts and caregiver access

One family account contains one person with diabetes and any number of caregivers.

The account owner controls who has access. Only the owner can invite or remove members. Invite codes are single-use and expire.

Every member can see who else is in the family. We do this deliberately, so nobody is watched without knowing it.

Caregivers see glucose information only. Readings, forecasts, patterns, statistics, alerts, and check-ins. They do not see journal entries, notes, labels, or anything else the patient writes. This is enforced by our servers.

If you invite someone, you are choosing to share your health information with them. We cannot control what they do with it. Remove access at any time; removal is immediate.

If you are a parent creating an account for a young person, you are responsible for that account and for the appropriateness of the access you grant.

6. Connecting your CGM

Apple Health. You may grant Remira permission to read glucose and related data. Revoke it at any time in iOS Settings. Our use of Apple Health data follows Apple’s HealthKit requirements in addition to these Terms.

Dexcom Share. Optional. If you connect it, you authorize Remira to sign in to Dexcom Share using the credentials you provide and to retrieve your readings on your behalf. We store those credentials encrypted.

FreeStyle LibreLinkUp. Optional. If you connect it, you authorize Remira to sign in to LibreLinkUp using the credentials you provide, to obtain an access token, and to retrieve readings from the sensor connection you select. We store your password, the token, and the connection details encrypted, and re-authenticate on your behalf when the token expires.

You must be entitled to the data you connect. LibreLinkUp works on a follower model. If you connect as a follower rather than as the person wearing the sensor, you confirm that the person wearing it knows and agrees that their readings will be shared with Remira. Do not connect an account or a sensor connection you are not authorized to access.

Remira is not affiliated with, endorsed by, or partnered with Dexcom, Abbott, or any CGM manufacturer. We use the sharing services those companies make available to followers. Either company may change, restrict, or discontinue those services at any time, and if that happens the feature will stop working — through no fault of ours and with no entitlement to a refund beyond what these Terms otherwise provide. Your use of Dexcom or FreeStyle Libre is governed by that company’s own terms.

Where the service supports it, we suggest using a dedicated follower account rather than your primary login. Disconnect at any time in settings, which deletes the stored credentials.

7. Subscriptions, trial, and payment

Free trial

New family accounts receive a 21-day free trial with full access. One trial per family. We may modify or discontinue trials for new users at any time.

Subscription

After the trial, continued access requires a subscription. Current pricing is $4.99 per month or $39.99 per year, or the price shown to you at the time you subscribe. Prices may change; existing subscribers receive at least 30 days’ notice before a change affects them, and you may cancel before it takes effect.

One subscription covers the whole family. Every member’s access is included.

How billing works

Subscriptions are purchased on remira-ai.com and processed by Stripe. They are not purchased through the App Store, and Apple does not process, service, or refund them.

Your subscription renews automatically at the end of each billing period until you cancel. You are charged the then-current price at the start of each period using the payment method on file. If your trial converts, the first charge occurs when the trial ends.

Cancelling

Cancel any time from your account page on remira-ai.com. Cancellation takes effect at the end of the current billing period, and you keep access until then. Cancelling during the trial means you are never charged.

We will not make you call, email, or chat with anyone to cancel.

Refunds

We do not offer refunds for partial periods, except where required by law. If something has gone wrong, email support@remira-ai.com — we would rather sort it out than have you feel cheated.

If your subscription lapses

Your data is not deleted. You lose access to Remira’s features until you resubscribe.
